title: CORRUPTED CROWN EVENT
body:
![Corrupted Crown EVent](https://images.ctfassets.net/7qho9llfhoio/2kcf9mSFrL39dOVMooRGNF/adc1b0dda4bad87f33e3a16ae3b2fe36/bg_slide_1__82_.jpg)

Greetings Dragon Masters!

Something corrupted has arrived in Dragon City... ⚠️

Forged from dark energy and fueled by Corrupted Crowns, the sinister Evil Dragon has declared war during this year's Summer Season. It's up to you and your dragons to fight back, complete daily challenges, and collect enough Crowns to stop the invasion.

The more you participate, the closer you'll get to claiming the Evil Dragon for yourself!

## ☠️ Defeat the Evil Dragon

Throughout the event, you'll collect Corrupted Crowns, the main currency used to progress through the event.

Spend your Crowns to unlock valuable rewards, collect Evil Dragon Orbs, and earn chances at the ultimate jackpot: The Evil Dragon itself!

## 👑 Ways to Collect Corrupted Crowns

There are plenty of opportunities every day to strengthen your progress:

#### 📅 Dragon City Calendar

Log in daily to claim your Daily Chest, packed with Corrupted Crowns and other rewards. The perfect starting point for every Dragon Master.

#### 🎲 Dragonverse Draw

Try your luck with affordable daily and weekly Gem Draws, featuring guaranteed large bundles of Corrupted Crowns to keep your journey moving forward.

#### ⚔️ Weekly Challenge

Face the Evil Dragon in an exclusive weekly battle and earn Evil Dragon Orbs together with additional Corrupted Crowns.

#### 💎 Summer Gem Passes

Progress through Free, Golden, and Platinum reward lanes by completing daily missions. Collect Gems, Corrupted Crowns, and even more valuable rewards along the way.

#### 🌐 Webstore Daily Streak

Visit the Webstore every day to complete your Daily Streak. Claim useful rewards throughout the week and finish your streak to earn a bonus bundle of Corrupted Crowns.

👑 Will You Save Dragon City?

Every Corrupted Crown brings you one step closer to defeating the Evil Dragon and unlocking incredible rewards. Complete your daily activities, keep your streak alive, and don't miss a single opportunity to push back the corruption before it's too late.

title: NEW FEATURE! PRESTIGE TIERS
body:
![PRETSIGE TIERS](https://images.ctfassets.net/7qho9llfhoio/26JzrKlOZSU6uNtgVI07cg/5264e6228066699c71f90a2d373601f8/bg_slide_1__77___1_.jpg)

Greetings Dragon Masters!

Today we have a new Feature coming to DC that will enhance the way you play and reward your commitment with the game!

## HOW IT WORKS: THE LOYALTY CYCLE 👑

This isn't just a one-time unlock; it’s a dynamic system that reflects your recent activity.

- Earn VIP Points: You gain points through purchases (In-game or Webstore) and specific event rewards.
- 21-Day Cycles: The system runs in 3-week "cycles."

**Promote:** Reach a point milestone mid-cycle to level up instantly.

**Shield your status:** Hit your tier's "checkpoint" to keep your status for the next cycle.

**Challenge reset:** If the checkpoint isn't met by the end of the 21 days, you'll drop one tier.

## THE PERKS: Powering Up Your Gameplay

Higher tiers unlock massive multipliers that make your daily grind much more rewarding:

**🚀 Multipliers:** Huge boosts to XP, Pet Food production, and Arena Leaderboard points.

**💎 Gems & Alliances:** High-tier players can get up to 5x Gems from Jewelem’s Tower and massive contribution boosts to Alliance Chests.

**🤝 Deus Trade:** A legendary perk for top tiers, perform one automatic trade per day without needing any partner to accept it!

**✨ Vanity:** Exclusive Bronze, Silver, and Gold Avatar Frames to show off your rank. (_Coming soon_)

title: YOUR PET IN DRAGON CITY CONTEST
body:
![Your Pet in Dragon City](https://images.ctfassets.net/7qho9llfhoio/1ckdB0f6enpFtWl7WBqjME/b157020c2ac7428bca8633f0e26d7b97/1520846785_DC_ASO_FeatureGraphic_2411DragonsLogoAOS_Main.jpg)

They sit on your keyboards. They judge your gameplay. They demand cuddles and snacks…

Yes, we’re talking about pets! 🐾

We’re celebrating our adorable companions with a special Community Contest. And who knows… your pet might even have a chance to be **featured in Dragon City**!

How, you might be wondering?

Read on for the rules to participate in our ✨**Your Pet in Dragon City Contest**!✨

---

### **PARTICIPATION RULES**

To participate in our Contest, take a **clear, high-quality photo** of **your real-life pet**.

The Submission must only contain the pet. Submissions containing the image or likeness of any human will be disqualified.

Eligible pets include dogs, cats, birds, small mammals (hamsters, rabbits, guinea pigs, ferrets, etc.), fish, and reptiles.

You have **until April 7th, 2026 at 11:59:00 PM CEST** to share your submission with us.

### **SUBMISSION RULES**

1. Send the submission to [**community.competition@socialpoint.es**](community.competition@socialpoint.es) with the subject line “**Pet Contest Entry – [Your Pet's Name]**”
2. Your Submission must include:

- Your pet’s photo (in the form of a JPG, JPEG, or PNG)
- Your pet’s name
- A one-sentence description of your pet’s personality

### **JUDGING CRITERIA**

We’ll choose our Winners based on

- Creativity and originality;
- Effectiveness in communicating your pet’s unique personality traits;
- Suitability for in-game adaptation.

### **WINNERS**

We’ll select a total of 3 (three) winners.

Each Winner will:

- Have their Submission of their pet adapted into an in-Game pet and released in a future Game update;
- Upon release in-Game, each Winner will receive their pet unlocked for free in their Game account.

The Winners will be notified on or about April 24, 2026 via the email address used when submitting their Submission.

🚨 Before taking part in the Contest, read carefully our T&Cs ➡️[**here**](https://rebrand.ly/DC/PetContestTCs)!

---

**NO PURCHASE NECESSARY. OPEN TO LEGAL RESIDENTS OF THE ELIGIBLE COUNTRIES WHO ARE AT LEAST 18 YEARS OF AGE. THE CONTEST BEGINS AT 12:00 PM CET ON 23/03/2026 AND ENDS AT 11:59 PM CEST ON 07/04/2026. VOID WHERE PROHIBITED. SUBJECT TO THE TERMS & CONDITIONS LOCATED AT** [**https://rebrand.ly/DC/PetContestTCs**](https://rebrand.ly/DC/PetContestTCs) **. Sponsor: Social Point.**

title: HALLOWEEN ART CONTEST
body:
![DC - HALLOWEEN ART CONTEST](https://images.ctfassets.net/7qho9llfhoio/3rmGCdabNDTYlBk9mTiVEP/5b7a664cd371fb58a56b53c3fd2399c0/DC_-_HALLOWEEN_NEWS.jpg)

Get your spooky creativity flowing, Dragon Masters! 🎨👻

Welcome to **Dragon City’s Halloween Art Contest**: we want to see your best Halloween-themed artwork! 🎃

Whether it’s a physical or digital artwork, we invite you all to unleash your creativity and win a special prize, as well as a spotlight on our social media! Don’t forget, Dragon City has to be the main focus of your Halloween drawings! 😉

Dare to participate?🐈‍⬛ Then read on for the rules!

---

### **PARTICIPATION RULES**

To participate in our Contest, you’re invited to **create a piece of art with the theme of Halloween and related to Dragon City**. It could be anything: a Skin for an existing Dragon City dragon, a new version of a Dragon City building, an Island, a decoration…whatever you like, as long as you incorporate some spooky vibes into your creation!

The use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools is not allowed.

You have **until November 3rd, 2025 at 12:00:00 PM CET** to share your submission with us.

### **SUBMISSION RULES**

To submit your creation, share an image of your creation with us via one of the following channels:

- **FACEBOOK:** Log in to your Facebook account and visit our [Official Dragon City page](https://www.facebook.com/DragonCity), find our [Contest post](https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=844177774618951&set=a.299790162391051) shared on October 27th, and add the image of your creation to the comments.
- **DISCORD:** Log in to our [Official Discord Server](https://discord.com/invite/dragoncity), locate the [Contest post](https://discordapp.com/channels/423511358173216778/1432353638767919174) on October 27th, and share the image of your art in the thread.

### **JUDGING CRITERIA**

We’ll choose our Winners based on the originality and creativity of the submission, how well the “Halloween theme” is incorporated into your drawing, as well as technical art skill.

### **WINNERS**

We’ll select a total of **10 winners** (5 on Facebook, and 5 on Discord).

Winners will be contacted on or around the 5th of November 2025 and awarded with the following in-game rewards🤩 🎉 :

🥇1st Place Winner: 130 Gems

🥈 2nd and 3rd Place Winners: 80 Gems

🥉 4th and 5th Place Winners: 40 Gems

To make sure you’re eligible before taking part in the Contest, read our T&Cs carefully [here](https://socialpoint.helpshift.com/hc/faq/4952-dragon-city-%E2%80%93-halloween-art-contest-terms-and-conditions/)!

And don’t forget, the Halloween celebrations continue in **🎃** [**Dragon City**](https://dragoncity.onelink.me/40H2/gge3jyxq)**!🎃**

---

NO PURCHASE NECESSARY. OPEN TO LEGAL RESIDENTS OF THE ELIGIBLE COUNTRIES WHO ARE AT LEAST 18 YEARS OF AGE. THE CONTEST BEGINS AT 12:00 PM CET ON 27/10/2025 AND ENDS AT 12:00 PM CET ON 03/11/2025. VOID WHERE PROHIBITED. SUBJECT TO THE TERMS & CONDITIONS LOCATED AT [https://rebrand.ly/DC/HalloweenContest25](https://rebrand.ly/DC/HalloweenContest25) . Sponsor: Social Point.

body:

There’s never a moment of peace in Dragon City…A civil war is about to break out, and a new Alliance of dragons is here to prevent it: make way for the Armored Alliance!

But who can hold them together? Every powerful team of dragons needs a valiant leader, and only an expert in defensive war strategies can claim that role!

✨[Head to your Dragon City](https://dragoncity.onelink.me/40H2/liluy15z )✨ and meet the High Civil Armored Dragon.

His motto? “_A strategic defense is the most powerful offense!_”

### **ARMOR SKILL**

The Armored Alliance members share a common trait: the **Armor Skill**!

Using the Armor Skill adds an extra bar of life points to your dragon, meaning your enemy will have to break down the Armor before damaging your dragon's life points.

The Armor can also have a set duration: for example, lasting 3 turns before it expires.

### **HIGH CIVIL ARMORED DRAGON & SKILL SKINS!**

This dragon is the first-ever Heroic Armored dragon!

Find him inside the new Divine Pass: Civil War.

##### **UNITED SKILL SKIN**

[**Go Elite on our Webstore**](https://rebrand.ly/DC/WebstoreWEB ) to get 300 of his Orbs, plus a special United Skill Skin to increase your High Civil Armored Dragon’s dealt damage for his Enchanted Armor & Paladin Spirit skills.

##### **ENCHANTED ARMOR**

This active Skill deals damage and applies 50% of Armor to your dragon.

##### **PALADIN SPIRIT SKILL**

This Skill deals damage to all your opponents.

##### **REBELLION SKILL SKIN**

By simply owning this Skin, your dragon's overall damage stat and life points will be boosted by 25%.

Find the Rebellion Skill Skin inside your **Sticker Album**!

---

Save[**this link**](https://rebrand.ly/DC/WebstoreWEB ) so you can come back to our Store tomorrow and unlock premium rewards with the Divine Pass, including Divine Points in your Elite Pass!

title: RESTORE CORAL REEFS WITH OUR CONSERVATION DAY PASS
body:
![DC - CONSERVATION DAY PASS](https://images.ctfassets.net/7qho9llfhoio/4n6aapTEdI2WeLvfcJDO2f/46fce1be165cdf6a415066717692d7b0/DC_-_JUL25_CONSERVATION_PASS_NEWS.jpg)

World Nature Conservation Day is around the corner, and to raise awareness about the importance of preserving and protecting our natural environment, we’ve teamed up once again with Dots.eco, this time to help restore coral reefs around the world. 🪸

Coral reefs are some of the most important ecosystems in the world. They provide habitat and food to many fish species and reduce coastal erosion, reducing the damage of floods and big storms. Thus, they play an important role in the lives of coastal communities.

If you’re curious to learn more about the importance of coral reefs and how this partnership can contribute to their restoration, check out [**Dots.eco webpage**](https://dots.eco/impact-coral-reef-restoration/)! ☺️

And it’s for this reason that we encourage all of our Dragon Masters around the globe to participate in our special [**Conservation Day Pass**](https://dragoncity.onelink.me/40H2/05gyhaea)! 🪸🐠

### CONSERVATION DAY PASS

From July 25th to August 2nd, complete all missions in our [**Conservation Day Pass**](https://dragoncity.onelink.me/40H2/05gyhaea) and make a real impact in restoring coral reefs, the lungs of the sea! 💙

#### PATH REWARDS

For each Path you unlock, you’ll be granted different rewards:

- Engage with the **Free Path** to earn a **Seashell Crystal** at the final milestone. This valuable item increases the speed of Gold production by 20% for each nearby dragon with the Sea element.
- Unlock the **Golden Tier** to reach the **Reef Preservation Award**, and be rewarded for your contribution with your own personalized certificate from Dots.eco!
- Unlock the **Platinum Tier** to reach the **Ascended Cosmos Dragon**! This comes with all the benefits of the Golden Tier, including your personalized certificate from Dots.eco, of course!

### PERSONALIZED CERTIFICATE

Your personalized certificate from Dots.eco will be made available in EVENTS in Settings, and you’ll be able to share it with your family and friends on social media to show off what you’ve accomplished by participating in our Conservation Day Pass!

Sharing this Certificate on your social media will also help us raise awareness and increase the visibility of this special cause, hopefully motivating more players to make a difference! 💙🪸

Don’t wait any longer and ✨ [**join us in Dragon City**](https://dragoncity.onelink.me/40H2/05gyhaea) ✨ to participate in our Conservation Day Pass!

---

_💡Remember to update your game to the latest version available in your Official App Store in order for the Conservation Day Pass to appear!_

title: NEW STICKER ALBUM!
body:
![STICKER ALBUM!](https://images.ctfassets.net/7qho9llfhoio/12qKveLQs0FpMxXP59k84m/8ec8ab2640076cf90ca0de67bcb94be6/splash_mobile__3_.jpg)

Have you always wanted to collect stickers of your beloved dragons? Starting today, you can, with a new feature: ✨[**Sticker Albums!**](https://dragoncity.onelink.me/40H2/dian7bxh) ✨

Sticker Albums are a 42-day time-limited event during which you can collect unique Stickers to complete Sets and ultimately an entire Sticker Album.

You’ll be able to unlock this feature at Level 7!

For each Set you complete, you’ll earn huge rewards, such as Joker Orbs, Food Chests, Perks, and even special dragons!

### START YOUR HUNT FOR STICKERS:

Stickers can be found inside Sticker Packs.

These Sticker Packs are distributed across different game features, including Divine Pass Seasons, the Login Calendar, Event Leaderboards, Milestone Passes, Event Islands, Quests, and inside the special Diamond Shop!

### HOW RARE IS YOUR STICKER?

The number of Diamonds on each Sticker indicates how rare your Sticker is.

The more Diamonds it has, the rarer it is!

Shiny Stickers are extra special and can only be found inside the Shiny Sticker Packs – so keep an eye out for them to complete all your sets!

### GOT DUPLICATE STICKERS? NO PROBLEM!

Duplicate Stickers are as useful as ever!

Your Duplicated Stickers will be automatically converted into Diamonds, which you can then spend in the brand-new Diamond Shop to get Rewards. The rarity of the Sticker indicates how many Diamonds each duplicate is worth.

Duplicate Shiny Stickers will be converted into Shiny Diamonds, which you can spend on exclusive packs in the Diamond Shop.

---

Now it’s time to start on your Sticker Album!

Update your game and ✨ [**head to your Dragon City**](https://dragoncity.onelink.me/40H2/dian7bxh) ✨  to start collecting your Sticker Packs!

_💡 Please note that this feature is still in its testing phase, so not all of our Dragon Masters may have access to it just yet! Stay tuned for more information regarding its global release!_
